## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why the change belongs in this pull request.

## Validation

List the exact commands and focused scenarios you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept parsing, orchestration, and GitHub adapters within their documented boundaries.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for every behavior change.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check`, or documented why a check could not run.
- [ ] I generated `dist/` from source and did not edit bundle files manually.
- [ ] I reviewed bundled dependency licenses and notices when dependencies changed.
- [ ] I updated public usage, input, output, permission, or recovery documentation when applicable.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, private data, and organization-specific defaults.
- [ ] My commits and pull-request title follow Conventional Commits.
